recruitment.named_source: founder-managed professional network of directors and engineers at construction companies that bid for or execute public works
eligibility_all_of: works in company direction, bids/proposals, engineering, contracts or public-works delivery
company bids for or executes public works
has participated in an edital, measurement, glosa, amendment or rebalancing decision in the last 24 months
can complete both protocols without coaching
exclusions_any_of: CONFENGE team member or implementation contributor
was coached on the navigation, evidence panel or offer wording
does not provide explicit research consent
recruitment.quota_policy: No result is calculated from fewer than five eligible, consented completions. Replacements must independently pass the same screen.

privacy.private_store: access-controlled CONFENGE operations storage outside git, issues, analytics and _site

retention.aggregate_no_pii: versioned while the decision remains auditable

tasks.prompt: Você recebeu um edital de obra pública e precisa avaliar riscos antes de decidir se participa. Onde procuraria?
Uma medição da obra foi parcialmente glosada e você precisa organizar a contestação. Onde procuraria?
Um evento extraordinário elevou custos do contrato e você precisa avaliar recomposição. Onde procuraria?

protocols.approval_rule: At least 80% of participants complete each named task without moderator correction or explanation; at the minimum sample this is four of five.
protocols.rejection_rule: Any task below 80% success is REPROVADO and requires an evidence-derived taxonomy proposal before retest.

protocols.stimulus: current production-equivalent first viewport of the CONFENGE home page at the bound git SHA
questions: Que problema ela ajuda a resolver?
O que você faria em seguida?
Isto parece consultoria, software/produto, ou outra coisa? Por quê?
protocols.approval_rule: At least 80% identify the ICP, problem and plausible next action, and at least 80% do not misclassify the evidence panel as software/product; at the minimum sample this is four of five.
protocols.rejection_rule: Any dimension below 80% success is REPROVADO; record the observed confusion before considering move-after-hero or replacement.

rollback.private_data: do not restore deleted participant data; preserve consent withdrawal and retention deletions
rollback.public_surface: no public URL, canonical, robots, runtime or conversion flow changes
